edition_angle: Restoring prostate cellular homeostasis through targeted ROS scavenging and macrophage repolarization addresses chronic inflammatory tissue degeneration.

assignments.angle: Targeted nanotherapeutics deliver quercetin-zinc complexes to clear reactive oxygen species and drive macrophage M1-to-M2 repolarization in inflamed prostate tissue.
assignments.reason: Provides a robust, biophysical mechanism of action targeting oxidative stress and macrophage repolarization (Cell Shedding/Dark Mirror), balancing out the heavy concentration of neuro-focused stories in recent editions.
